summary.notes: Four strong claims (CL-001, CL-002, CL-006, CL-008) require explicit role-matched citations that are absent from the request. CL-001 and CL-002 assert renameability of architectural terms without SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_SEQUENCE_v1.md authorization. CL-006 lacks the scope-boundary definition needed for safe classification of individual occurrences. CL-008 asserts authority to modify the constitutional document without governance authorization — this is the highest-severity finding. The only compliant claim is CL-005 (fail-closed governance requirement), which ironically provides the constitutional basis for blocking the broader request. No README_LAYER2 override misuse was detected in the request itself (the file is only mentioned as a candidate for review, not cited as an authority). Doc-sync escalation is required because any approved rename would require coordinated updates across all seven canonical documents simultaneously.
